assertions.evidence: Multiple markdown tables present with pipe delimiters: 'Shipping Method Availability' and 'Shipping Cost Calculation'

assertions.text: Express shipping is split into at least two cases distinguishing the UK free tier (UK, order £50+, free) from the paid tier.
assertions.evidence: 'Express – exactly at threshold, UK (free tier)' £50 £0.00 vs 'Express – at or above threshold, non-UK' {£50, £75} £9.99

assertions.text: Express rows use value sets to consolidate cases with the same outcome
assertions.evidence: UK at/above threshold split as separate rows: '£50 | £0.00' and '£75 | £0.00' instead of '{£50, £75} | £0.00'

assertions.text: Overnight UK and Ireland are in one row using a value set ({UK, Ireland})

assertions.text: Standard shipping destination uses a value set or is blank

assertions.evidence: Standard destination uses {UK, Ireland, EU, International} value set because destination exists but doesn't affect cost

assertions.text: Multiple tables are used, each addressing a distinct concern

assertions.text: Each table has only the rows needed to express its concern's rules
assertions.evidence: Availability has 5 rows with Overnight UK/Ireland separate (rows 3-4); Cost table splits UK at-threshold into rows: '£50 | £0.00' and '£75 | £0.00'

assertions.text: Shipping method availability and cost are in separate tables
assertions.evidence: Model explicitly states concerns are 'which methods are available' and 'what they cost' with two distinct tables
